usage: The word 雀仔 (zoek3 zai2) refers to a small bird, usually a sparrow or similar little bird.
It is used as a noun to name a type of animal, specifically small birds you can often see in parks or gardens.
When using 雀仔 in sentences, it can act as the subject or object depending on the sentence structure.
雀仔 can be combined with verbs like '飛' (fly) or '食' (eat) to describe the actions of the bird.
You can also use 雀仔 in plural or general sense without adding a plural marker, as Cantonese nouns do not change form for number.
